title: Figure 3.56 label: oxidation of sulphide in the sewage
applicability: Label 'OXIDATION OF SULPHIDE:' printed in the sewage zone of Figure 3.56. The same block prints 'DISSOLVED SULPHIDE PRESENT, HS⁻ + H₂S' and 'DISSOLVED OXYGEN LESS THAN 0.1 mg/l'.
notes: Printed as '2 O₂ + 2 HS⁻ — S₂O₃²⁻ + H₂O'; the two sides are separated by a horizontal dash, not by a reaction arrow like the pipe-wall reaction elsewhere in the same figure. Preserved verbatim; not corrected.
